Strategy: Choose the bin whose placement most equalizes the remaining residuals, minimizing the spread between the loosest and tightest bin after placement. Balanced residuals may stay usable longer. It may help by avoiding extreme bins, but may fail if equalizing wastes tight bins that a future large item needs.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(max([x - item if x == r else x for x in bins]) - min([x - item if x == r else x for x in bins])) for r in bins]
```
